speaker: narrator
text: [excited] Ten goblins. One mine shaft. Nine thousand pegs. Welcome to the Grand Prix of Marblehurst — keep your ball rolling and your teeth gritted!

speaker: sprocket
text: Oi, I'm Sprocket! Steering's easy: left, right, and pray. Hit the orange pegs, mind the crushers, and do not — I repeat, do not — stop for the sheep. [laughs] Let's roll!

speaker: duchess-vex
text: Do try to keep up, darling. I own this mountain, this track, and the goblin who polishes my trophy case. You? You are scenery.
